summary: This SEC Form 6-K filed by Infosys Limited (a foreign private issuer) reports the outcome of its 45th Annual General Meeting held on June 25, 2026. The filing includes the proceedings, chairman's speech, CEO presentation, e-voting results, and the scrutinizer's report, along with an intimation regarding reclassification of certain promoter group members under SEBI regulations. No special-situation corporate event (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or activist campaign) is disclosed; the filing is purely a routine mandatory disclosure of periodic shareholder meeting results. Thus, it does not qualify for any special-situations category.
